name: Finland
prevalence_note: Poliisi and Traficom warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for bank credentials and moving money to a 'safe account', fake police or tax staff asking for online bank codes, and fake technical support.
cross_border_note: Traficom's mandatory CLI-filtering regulation blocks unverified international inbound calls spoofing Finnish (+358) fixed and mobile numbers at international gateways; cross-border valepoliisi, bank safety-account, and tech-support scammers shift to foreign (+44/+46) prefixes, SMS callback lures, or SIM-box relays in Finnish and Swedish.

scams.name: Valepankkivirkailija: pankkitunnukset ja turvatili
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking for credentials and a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks for bank credentials, a confirmation code or a move of money to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Finnish banks never ask for bank credentials or codes by phone and never move money to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pankin sovellus päivittyy, ja pyytää selittämään uudestaan rauhassa
Kysyä, minä päivänä siirto tehtiin ja kuinka suuri summa

scams.name: Valepoliisi tai -viranomainen: identiteettivarkaus
scams.name_en: Fake police or authority about identity theft
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police, the tax office or Traficom speaks of identity theft or a criminal case and asks for online bank codes, card details or a password.
scams.legit_en: The police and other authorities never ask for online bank codes, card details or passwords by phone.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pitää etsiä silmälasit, ja pyytää toistamaan hitaasti

scams.name: Vale tekninen tuki: etähallintaohjelma
scams.name_en: Fake tech support with a remote-control program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a virus or a licence problem and asks to install a remote-control program and enter credit card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses or licences and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että tietokone käynnistyy hitaasti, ja kysyä, mitä ruudulla pitäisi näkyä

scams.name: Falsk banktjänsteman, Skatteförvaltningen eller polis (säkerhetskonto & bankkoder)
scams.name_en: Fake Finnish bank officer, Vero tax official, or police in Swedish demanding safe-account transfer or banking codes
scams.signals_en: Caller speaks Swedish to Swedish-speaking Finns, posing as a Finnish bank security unit, Skatteförvaltningen (Vero), or police, alleging unauthorized loans or transfers and pressuring the victim to share nätbank codes or move savings to a supposed...
scams.legit_en: Finnish banks, Skatteförvaltningen (Vero), and Poliisi/Polisen never ask for banking codes by phone and never instruct citizens to transfer funds to a 'säkerhetskonto'.
bait_tactics: Säg lugnt att nyckelkodlistan eller telefonen med mobilbanken ligger på stugan eller i ett låst skåp och be dem vänta medan du letar
Be uppringaren upprepa avdelningsnamnet långsamt på svenska och fråga vilket kontor i Helsingfors eller Vasa samtalet kopplats från
Påstå att nätbankens inloggningssida bara visar ett felmeddelande om underhåll och be dem förklara varje knapptryckning på nytt
